title: Design Auditory Filter Bank
text: Design frequency-domain auditory filter bank, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Frequency scale} sets Frequency scale of filter bank; {Mel style}, {FFT length} sets the number of DFT points, {Design one-sided filter bank} sets the design one-sided or two-sided filter bank, {Auto-determine number of bands} sets the automatically determine number of bandpass, {Number of bands} sets the number of bandpass filters, {Auto-determine frequency range} sets the automatically determine frequency range, {Frequency range (Hz)} sets the frequency range over which to design auditory filter bank, {Filter bank design domain} sets the domain to design filter, {Filter bank normalization} sets the normalization technique for filter bank, {Output data type} sets the data type, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate 44.1e3, {Visualize filter bank} sets the open plot to visualize filter and {Output center frequencies} sets the additional output port for center. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Frequency scale
params.values: Frequency scale of filter bank mel (default) | bark | erb

params.name: FFT length
params.values: Number of DFT points 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Design one-sided filter bank
params.values: Design one-sided or two-sided filter bank on (default) | off

params.name: Auto-determine number of bands
params.values: Automatically determine number of bandpass filters on (default) | off

params.name: Number of bands
params.values: Number of bandpass filters 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Auto-determine frequency range
params.values: Automatically determine frequency range on (default) | off

params.name: Frequency range (Hz)
params.values: Frequency range over which to design auditory filter bank [0,22050] (default) | two-element row vector

params.name: Filter bank design domain
params.values: Domain to design filter bank linear (default) | warped

params.name: Filter bank normalization
params.values: Normalization technique for filter bank bandwidth (default) | area | none

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output double (default) | single

params.name: Visualize filter bank
params.values: Open plot to visualize filter bank button

params.name: Output center frequencies
params.values: Specify additional output port for center frequencies off (default) | on
